import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
RES3={'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}; CH={'ARG':1,'LYS':1,'ASP':-1,'GLU':-1}
MAXA={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLN':225,'GLU':223,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,'ILE':197,'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,'TYR':263,'VAL':174}
ONE={v:k for k,v in zip('ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV',['ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL'])}

def parse(txt,chain,minpl=None):
    res={}
    for L in txt.splitlines():
        if not L.startswith('ATOM') or L[21]!=chain or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in RES3: continue
        el=(L[76:78].strip() or L[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
        if el not in VDW: continue
        res.setdefault((int(L[22:26]),rn),[[],[],[]])
        res[(int(L[22:26]),rn)][0].append((float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
        res[(int(L[22:26]),rn)][1].append(el); res[(int(L[22:26]),rn)][2].append(float(L[60:66]))
    out=[]
    for (num,rn),(xyz,els,bs) in sorted(res.items()):
        if minpl is not None and np.mean(bs)<minpl: continue
        out.append((num,rn,np.array(xyz),els))
    return out

def sasa(residues,nsp=92):
    k=np.arange(nsp)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*k/nsp); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
    SP=np.stack([np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)],1)
    C=np.vstack([r[2] for r in residues]); R=np.array([VDW[e] for r in residues for e in r[3]])+1.4
    own=np.concatenate([[i]*len(r[3]) for i,r in enumerate(residues)])
    tree=cKDTree(C); rmax=R.max(); per=np.zeros(len(residues))
    for i in range(len(C)):
        nb=np.array(tree.query_ball_point(C[i],R[i]+rmax)); nb=nb[nb!=i]
        pts=C[i]+R[i]*SP
        acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-C[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)>=R[nb][None,:]).all(1) if len(nb) else np.ones(nsp,bool)
        per[own[i]]+=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.sum()/nsp
    return per

def analyse(rr,label,verbose=False):
    A=sasa(rr); rel=np.array([A[i]/MAXA[r[1]] for i,r in enumerate(rr)])
    q=np.array([CH.get(r[1],0) for r in rr]); exp=rel>0.25
    idx=np.where((q>0)&exp)[0]; best=(0,0.0,[])
    if len(idx):
        Cc=np.vstack([rr[i][2].mean(0) for i in idx]); D=np.linalg.norm(Cc[:,None]-Cc[None,:],axis=2)<=10.0
        seen=set()
        for s in range(len(idx)):
            if s in seen: continue
            st=[s]; comp=[]
            while st:
                u=st.pop()
                if u in seen: continue
                seen.add(u); comp.append(u); st+=[v for v in np.where(D[u])[0] if v not in seen]
            a=A[idx[comp]].sum()
            if (len(comp),a)>best[:2]: best=(len(comp),a,[idx[c] for c in comp])
    tot=A.sum()
    if verbose and best[2]:
        print(f"  {label} largest basic patch residues: "
              +", ".join(f"{ONE[rr[i][1]]}{rr[i][0]}({A[i]:.0f}A2)" for i in sorted(best[2],key=lambda i: rr[i][0])))
    return dict(label=label,n=len(rr),netq=int(q.sum()),q_per100=100*q.sum()/len(rr),
                basic_frac=A[(q>0)&exp].sum()/tot, acidic_frac=A[(q<0)&exp].sum()/tot,
                patch_n=best[0],patch_SASA=best[1],patch_frac=best[1]/tot)

PANEL=[("1QAG","A","Utrophin ABD (CH1-CH2)"),("1AOA","A","Fimbrin ABD2 (CH3-CH4)"),
       ("1COF","A","Cofilin / ADF-H"),("1YAG","G","Gelsolin segment 1"),
       ("1YAG","A","Actin (G-actin)"),("1HPC","A","GcvH H-protein (fold control)"),
       ("1UBQ","A","Ubiquitin (size-matched control)")]
rows=[]
for p,c,d in PANEL:
    txt=S.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb',timeout=60).text
    rr=parse(txt,c); print(f"{p}_{c}: {len(rr)} res  [{d}]")
    rows.append(analyse(rr,f"{p}_{c} {d}",verbose=True))
meta=S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q80ZQ9',timeout=90).json()[0]
af=S.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=90).text; assert len(af)>50000
ab=parse(af,'A',minpl=70); print(f"AF-Q80ZQ9 core: {len(ab)} res ({ab[0][0]}-{ab[-1][0]})")
rows.append(analyse(ab,"Abitram core (AF-Q80ZQ9, pLDDT>=70)",verbose=True))

df=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',220)
print(); print(df.round(4).to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('/agent/jobs/7fa3ef47-758c-4d83-8be4-ef31af2ced2a/provenance/surface_charge_panel.csv',index=False)

lab=[r['label'].split(' ',1)[1] for r in rows]; col=['#4878a8']*5+['#999999','#999999']+['#c44e52']
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
o=np.argsort([r['patch_SASA'] for r in rows])
ax[0].barh([lab[i] for i in o],[rows[i]['patch_SASA'] for i in o],color=[col[i] for i in o])
ax[0].set_xlabel('Largest contiguous exposed Lys/Arg patch (A$^2$)')
ax[0].set_title('Basic surface patch size')
ax[1].scatter([r['q_per100'] for r in rows],[r['patch_SASA'] for r in rows],c=col,s=90)
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    ax[1].annotate(lab[i],(r['q_per100'],r['patch_SASA']),fontsize=7.5,xytext=(4,4),textcoords='offset points')
ax[1].axvline(0,color='k',lw=0.6,ls=':')
ax[1].set_xlabel('Net charge per 100 residues'); ax[1].set_ylabel('Largest basic patch (A$^2$)')
ax[1].set_title('Abitram (red) vs actin-binding modules (blue) and controls (grey)')
fig.suptitle('Abitram presents a larger contiguous basic patch than four characterised actin-binding modules',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
